infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reality Quest AI requires camera access to scan physical objects and transform them into AR game relics.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reality Quest AI requires GPS location to spawn local quests, anomalies, and resource nodes around you.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Reality Quest AI to access your camera to scan real-world objects.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Reality Quest AI to use your location for the AR World Map.
